searchText.title: Search Text
searchText.description: A string containing general terms for the search.

resultCount.title: Result Count
resultCount.description: (Optional) The maximum number of top results to return.The default value is 10. For example, if Result Count is set to 5 and there are more than 5 results that meet the specified criteria, then only the top 5 results are returned.

retrievalMode.title: Retrieval Mode
retrievalMode.description: Retrieval mode. Optional, if not specified, default to Basic.

enableCitations.title: Citations
enableCitations.description: Enable or disable citations. Optional, if not specified, default to true.

clientName.title: Client Name
clientName.description: (Optional) Set a unique client name to track activity and usage for the calling client.

clientTraceId.title: Client Trace Id
clientTraceId.description: (Optional) Set a client-defined trace id for tracking the request from the calling client.
